name: Athisayan
summary: A clever orphan boy in Vinayan's 2007 Malayalam children's film who drinks an invisibility potion to rescue his guardian and is later changed into a giant called Athisayan by the same potion.
origin: Devan is an orphan raised by TV reporter Maya in Kerala, a child prodigy with a computer-like mind. When Maya is kidnapped for evidence against corrupt politicians, Devan drinks a scientist's invisibility potion to save her, unaware of its side effects. After he is shot, the potion changes him into a giant, and he becomes Athisayan. Master Devadas played him in this 2007 film, in which his real father also acts.
powers: Giant size and strength after mutation
Resistance to harm from the potion

storyline.title: A prodigy and a potion
storyline.beat: Devan, a gifted orphan raised by reporter Maya, watches scientist R. C. Shekhar test his invisibility potion on a rabbit before the scientist leaves for the US.

storyline.title: The boy who vanished
storyline.beat: When Maya is kidnapped over a bribery video, Devan sneaks into the lab, drinks the potion, becomes invisible and sets out to save her.

storyline.title: The giant appears
storyline.beat: A side effect of the potion transforms Devan into a giant when he is shot while protecting someone, and he deals with the wrongdoers.

storyline.title: Gone to the deep ocean
storyline.beat: Devan leaves Maya and the children and makes his home in the deep ocean, with a promise that Athisayan will return to fight for justice.

gossip.text: Jackie Shroff made his Malayalam film debut in Athisayan as the scientist R. C. Shekhar.
The film was inspired by the 2003 Hollywood film Hulk, according to Wikipedia.
Singer Sithara began her playback career with a song in this film.
Its Hindi dub, titled Naya Ajooba, was released in 2009.
Devadas's real father, actor Ramu, plays one of the film's corrupt ministers.

quiz.q: Which Hollywood film is said to have inspired Athisayan?
quiz.why: Wikipedia says the film was inspired by the 2003 film Hulk.

quiz.q: What does Devan drink to become invisible?
quiz.why: He drinks Shekhar's invisibility potion without knowing its side effects.

quiz.q: Which Bollywood actor made his Malayalam debut in the film?
quiz.why: Jackie Shroff plays the scientist R. C. Shekhar.

theme.tagline: An invisible boy and a giant of the deep sea.

timeline.title: Athisayan opens in Kerala

timeline.title: A singer's first song

timeline.title: The Athisayan boy is back
timeline.note: A November 2018 Deccan Chronicle profile covers Devadas returning to acting in Kalikkoottukar.

facts.text: Scientist R. C. Shekhar tests an invisibility potion on a rabbit while Devan watches, and that moment plants the idea in the boy's head.
The potion saves Devan from a bullet, but as a side effect it turns him into an aggressive giant, and during the fight he saves a child.
Shekhar warns that no metal object should scratch Devan once the potion has changed him, a rule tied to the potion's strange side effects.
Devadas's real father, the actor Bhasi Padikkal, credited as Ramu, plays the corrupt minister Yunus Kunju in the same film.
The giant hero is called Devan, and the villain Kuwait Nazar is played by an actor who is also named Devan.
Guinness Pakru appears in Athisayan as Ramu. His Guinness record, shortest actor in a leading adult role at 76 cm (2008), came from Vinayan's earlier film Athbhutha Dweepu, not from this one.
The plot hangs on a memory card: reporter Maya films powerful politicians taking big sums, and Devan loses the card during his rescue but later finds it in his own pockets.
Maya grew up in an orphanage under Father Chanthakkadan, and as a grown reporter she takes in several street kids to raise, Devan among them.
Once scientist Shekhar returns from the US, he plans to make the invisible Devan visible again, while the villains close in on the memory card.
Devadas has said he had no idea the film would be a hit or that he was entering a big industry. What excited the young boy most was that he could skip school.
After years away, Devadas returned in 2018 as the lead of Kalikkoottukar, a story of six friends written by his father, the actor Bhasi Padikkal, known on screen as Ramu.
Athisayan was the first film Devadas shot, but Anandabhairavi, which he also acted in, was released first, so audiences met him in that film before this one.
Director Vinayan told The Hindu in April 2006 that he considered Athishayan the first science-fiction thriller of its kind in Malayalam cinema.
The Hindu's set visit described the scientist's lab as stuffed with test tubes and beakers, with skeletons in a corner and a corpse in a glass coffin for a spooky scientist's den.
During a lab scene on set, young Devadas was to drop a beaker. He fumbled it for real, it broke, and the crew laughed because the take came out perfect.
Vinayan said the boy's name roughly means 'amazing person', and that the reason he is called that was a closely guarded secret to be revealed only on screen.
In April 2006 the film was being readied for an Onam release, yet it reached cinemas only on 17 April 2007, in the summer holidays.
Aluva, one of the main shooting locations, shows up in the title of Sithara's debut song, Aluva Manappurathe, which many remember by its Pammi Pammi Vanne hook.
The scientist's assistant is billed with a nickname, 'Einstein' Damodaran, and is played by Harisree Ashokan.
The film is said to be inspired by Hulk (2003), with a boy turning into an aggressive giant, and its effects and 2D animation were made at EFX in Chennai.

kidSummary: Devan is a super-smart orphan boy who lives with a kind reporter named Maya. When bad people take her away, he drinks a scientist's invisibility potion and sneaks off to save her. A side effect of the potion later turns him into a giant who stops the wrongdoers.

story.title: A clever boy
story.text: Devan is a bright orphan who lives with the reporter Maya and other children she looks after.

story.title: The potion
story.text: He watches a scientist test an invisibility potion on a rabbit, and the idea sticks in his head.

story.title: Invisible rescue
story.text: When Maya is kidnapped, Devan drinks the potion, turns invisible and sets out to save her.

story.title: The giant
story.text: A side effect of the potion changes him into a giant, and he stops the wrongdoers who hurt his family.

story.title: A promise from the deep
story.text: Devan makes his home in the deep ocean, promising that Athisayan will return whenever justice needs him.
